title: Node C communication failure (stays offline)
description: After 3 s Node C stops sending readings. The line itself is electrically normal.
what_to_look_for: Node C shows 'No data' – not 0 V.
Status DEGRADED / UNKNOWN – not FAULT SUSPECTED, because missing data is not evidence of a broken line.

button.label: Node Communication Failure
button.does: After 3 s, Node C stops sending readings. The simulated line itself stays normal.
button.wait: Node C shows Stale Data after about 6 s and Offline after about 13 s; the 'Node offline' event appears then.

checks.text: Node C shows Stale Data, then Offline – no voltage number, never 0 V.
Node C is marked Offline (no valid report for more than 10 s).
Fault location: No interruption detected (a silent node is not treated as lost supply).
A 'Node offline (no data)' event appears (after about 10 s).
